TDD per task with task reviews (subagent-driven). root 582/582, typecheck exit 0, vendor web 118/120 (2 pre-existing sprite-avatar failures), vendor tsc app/node exit 0, build exit 0 (2026-10-13). Single-Mac two-Office real check passed end to end. Uncommitted pending user review.

Per-task reviews (spec + quality; opus for security-relevant tasks) and one final whole-branch review (opus) incl. token scope, (member, origin repo) scope, window key + rate limit, no token to the browser, hubout delegation not leaking G4/task G1, legacy detection, CSRF: Critical 0; 4 Important fixed and re-reviewed (all addressed); the re-review's new Important (send upsert losing task_id) and hub-boundary option-1 enforcement fixed on user decision. Residual minors parked in docs/verification/2026-10-13-team-hub-office-send.md.

Fresh verification 2026-10-13 after all fixes: npm test 582/582 (exit 0), npm run typecheck exit 0, vendor vitest 118/120 (2 pre-existing sprite-avatar failures, also failing before this change), vendor tsc app/node exit 0, build:office exit 0, Story/Task checkers exit 0. Unproven: other PCs, company IT policy, legacy-hub mix in real use, chat send and PM questions/planning retry in real use (automated only).
